notes_for_editor: No status, height, design, access, or build date appears in any source read; the record's status and access stay unknown. The state list on the Forest Lookouts site has two Oberlin entries (Site 1 and Site 2, both Allen Parish), but the record has one OSM point (node 358380308); check which site it is. The NOAA station carries the tower's name and its coordinates are close to the record point, but the station record does not prove the tower stood in 1952 and does not describe it. The 1915 to 1950 statewide figures come from Wikipedia, whose history section cites sources this run could not confirm; the statement is about the state network, not this tower. No NHLR or FFLOS listing for Oberlin in the cached registers.
